fields.label: Icon (class)
fields.description: Phosphor class (e.g. 'ph-duotone ph-truck' or 'ph ph-truck', see phosphoricons.com); Font Awesome / Octicon classes still work. Ignored if an Icon Image is uploaded.

fields.label: Icon Image
fields.description: Optional. Upload a logo/image to use as the tile icon. Takes precedence over the icon class.

fields.label: Accent Colour
fields.description: Optional hex (e.g. #1F4E79). Defaults to the theme primary.

fields.label: Target Route
fields.description: Desk route the tile opens, e.g. 'sales-order/new', 'crm-mobile' or 'sales-order' (no /app or /desk prefix); a website page is an absolute path such as '/guides'.

fields.label: Open in New Tab
fields.description: When enabled, the tile opens the route in a new browser tab instead of navigating within the desk.

fields.label: Show As
fields.description: Header icon = a round button next to Home and Refresh on the header bar (label becomes the tooltip) instead of a tile in the grid.

fields.label: Count Method
fields.description: Optional. A whitelisted method (or Server Script API name) called for the person signed in. Returns a number -> red badge while above 0 (e.g. 'nest_stock_request.api.issue_count'); or {"counts": [{"value": 3, "color": "#B45309", "title": "Unallocated"}, ...]} -> one coloured pill per entry.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Optional sub-label shown under the tile title.

fields.label: Allowed Roles
fields.description: Leave empty to show the tile to everyone.
